CustomField.description: The strength at which the Status Bar Message is displayed. This controls the visibility and size of the icon displayed next to the message. Use 0 for no image, or 1-3 (highest strength, largest icon).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The strength at which the Status Bar Message is displayed. This controls the visibility and size of the icon displayed next to the message. Use 0 for no image, or 1-3 (highest strength, largest icon).
CustomField.label: Status Bar Message 1 Strength
